name: Dwarf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Reads the light band one brighter for your own rolls: Detection, aim and the ambush roll when you are the party's best Perception. Loot stays at the true band.

traits.name: Stonefoot
traits.description: Immune to Root and to every forced row move. Poison damage ×0.70; Poison lands 30% less often.

traits.name: Forge-born
traits.description: Field Repair counts two ranks higher (may exceed 10); material promotions cost 10% less gold.

traits.name: Short Stride
traits.description: −5 base Speed and a Mana pool at ×0.90: the slowest body before armor, and thin for casters.

restrictions.reason: Too short in the draw; shortbows and crossbows are fine.

creationBlurb: Stout, slow and very hard to move. Sees in the dark and never leaves the front row.
